series: plain ratio P_a / P_b on the last trading day of each ISO week (pair_frame); weekly change g_t = ln(r_t / r_t-1)

point_in_time.drift: expanding mean of the weekly changes before week t
point_in_time.zigzag_h: expanding sd (n - 1) of the weekly changes before week t * sqrt(26)
point_in_time.random_walks: the point-in-time residuals with random signs; no demeaning

look_ahead_check.what: history cut at 12 dates per pair: estimates up to the cut equal the full run's, turning points are a prefix of the full run's, and the z-score equals the full run's (to 1e-12)

zscore.definition: z_t = (r_t - mean of the last 52 weekly closes including t) / their sd (n - 1), from week 42: T02's band, z = ±1 is its edge
zscore.scope: description only: nothing about what follows a band touch (no return, no time back to the mean, no hit rate)
zscore.random_paths: the real warm-up weeks, then each point-in-time residual with the page's random sign plus the expanding drift (the drift check's version B); z on the path's ratio; turning points from the zig-zag on its drift-removed path
zscore.window: from the end of the warm-up to the last week, as the rest of the page; stretches running at either end are cut there

checks.engine: (ratio - mean) / sd from analysis.ratio_engine.decide(plain, window 52); only those columns read

drift_check.what: A = expanding drift removed (the page); B = no drift removal, random walks with the expanding drift added back
drift_check.by_check: variance ratios 8 of 62, swings 1 of 30, spectrum bands 0 of 69
